title: SB1040 (112th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 37 and Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13, relative to the transfer of firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2021-02-10; crossfiled twin's official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514133755 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/112/Bill/HB1160.pdf (it names SENATE BILL 1040; own link https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/112/Bill/SB1040.pdf not archived))
provenance.note: Draft as filed 2021-02-10, read from the House twin's document (HB 1160 / SB 1040). Subsection (b) excepts supervised age-restricted use for instruction, hunting or sport shooting. Effective July 1, 2021.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (new TCA 39-17-1305): (a) The offense of illegal transfer of a firearm to a prohibited possessor is committed when a person intentionally gives, sells, donates, lends, delivers, or otherwise transfers a firearm to another person and the transferor knows or reasonably should know that the person receiving the firearm is prohibited from purchasing or possessing a firearm under state or federal law.
SECTION 1 (new TCA 39-17-1305): (c) A violation of this section is a Class A misdemeanor.
